name: CloudCasa by Catalogic
summary:
CloudCasa by Catalogic provides Kubernetes backup, disaster recovery, and migration solutions for cloud-native and enterprise infrastructure environments.

Together, we help organisations design, integrate, and operate CloudCasa environments across secure Kubernetes and cloud infrastructure platforms. From backup and recovery through to migration, resilience, and operational governance, we help teams create scalable, reliable, and operationally consistent cloud-native environments.
overview:
CloudCasa by Catalogic helps organisations protect, recover, and migrate Kubernetes workloads across cloud, hybrid, and on-premises infrastructure environments. The platform provides Kubernetes-native backup, disaster recovery, migration, and replication capabilities with support for SaaS and self-hosted deployments.  

Together, we help organisations build, integrate, and operate CloudCasa environments across enterprise Kubernetes infrastructure. From backup and disaster recovery through to workload migration and operational governance, we help teams create environments that are secure, resilient, and operationally consistent.

Our focus is on building reliable Kubernetes platform foundations that support long-term operational resilience and recovery readiness. This includes backup automation, disaster recovery, observability, lifecycle management, migration enablement, and operational support across complex cloud-native environments.

We help organisations improve workload resilience, reduce operational risk, and operate Kubernetes platforms with confidence.
